name: PixVerse (Legacy; EOL soon)
original_description:
This legacy plugin will be retired soon. Please install the new PixVerse plugin to continue receiving updates:
https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6adab2e460408191a82e46388be67a30

After installing and verifying the new plugin, you can uninstall this legacy version.

Give your ideas a visual form with PixVerse. Start with a prompt or a reference image, explore a direction, and shape the result through conversation.

Use PixVerse to:
• Generate short videos from a written scene or bring a still image to life with motion.
• Create and edit images, from product photography and character sheets to brand visuals and mockups.
• Develop video concepts and complete scripts with dialogue, narration and scene direction.
• On desktop, edit footage, add captions and audio, and assemble shots into finished videos. Use Canvas to organize references and build connected creative projects.

ChatGPT web and mobile support short video generation, image creation and edits, product photos, character sheets, brand visuals and scripts. Advanced video editing, audio production and Canvas are available through the desktop toolkit.

Connect your PixVerse account to get started.
